title: A/R Detail does not remember expanded groups
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin user (the "Admin" role).
  • Make sure the report has open documents on today's date in several buckets.
  • Use a desktop browser window 1440 px wide.
  • Open A/R Detail (Reports, then "A/R Aging Detail" under ACCOUNTS RECEIVABLE in the left menu).
  • If you cannot set up any of the above, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Note which groups are expanded.
  2. Click the chevron on the first bucket row to change it.
  3. Open Sales By Customer (Reports, then "Sales By Customer" under PERFORMANCE in the left menu).
  4. Open A/R Detail (Reports, then "A/R Aging Detail" under ACCOUNTS RECEIVABLE in the left menu) again.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Note the report's opening state.

Step 2:

  • That bucket changes (expands or collapses).

Step 3:

  • Sales By Customer opens.

Step 4:

  • A/R Detail opens in the same state as in step 1, not the state you left: the change is not remembered.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "A/R and A/P Report Sorting, Export and Location Filter", Confluence 947650561, version 9 (23 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), read 26 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11315, story SV-11534 (Story 4, Collapse all, Expand all and pinned group rows)

  • S4-R9: “Expanded state is not remembered between visits.”
